title: Uplifting Author Fyne Ogonor Unveils All-New Children's Book, 'The Shiny Rose' | User | minstercommunitypost.com
text:
In ‘The Shiny Rose’, families and children meet the Shiny Rose and a Talking Tree and learn the importance of loving self, caring for others, and building relationships
Fyne Ogonor is pleased to announce the release of her newest children’s book, ‘The Shiny Rose.’
Ogonor is an uplifting author, speaker, spiritual counselor, entrepreneur, educator, business consultant, and philanthropist. She has penned books for adults including ‘A Moving Train,’ ‘My Pledge!,’ and ‘Discover Your Coat of Many Colors.’ For youth and juvenile readers, Ogonor has written books including ‘The Best Gift Ever, and she has already warmed hearts around the world with her first children’s book, ‘Baby Eagle and The Chicks.’
Now, she is back with ‘The Shiny Rose,’ a children’s book that offers a story and moral lesson that adults and children can enjoy together. “What is that unique substance within you that magnets others to your being? If you’re not sure what it is, perhaps the story of The Shiny Rose and a Talking Tree will awaken your intellect to discover your built-in hidden treasure,” said Ogonor.
‘The Shiny Rose’ is a story for everyone, offering a tale that can be treasured by families together or individually during quiet time. This new children’s book is the perfect addition to home treasuries but also for school libraries and educator resources. Children, youth, and young adults can glean clarity into their true selves through ‘The Shiny Rose,’ who they truly are, and the essence of their being on earth.
In ‘The Shiny Rose,’ readers learn that while the tree, or the self, is important, it takes many trees to make a forest.
‘The Shiny Rose’ is now available via major booksellers including Amazon and Barnes and Noble . Learn more now by watching the promo video on YouTube and by visiting https://www.fyneogonor.com/ .
ABOUT FYNE OGONOR
Fyne Ogonor is an author, entrepreneur, educator, uplifting speaker, spiritual counselor, philanthropist, and business consultant who places God at the center of her ambition to serve others. Follow Fyne Ogonor on social media:
